figures.title: 同一段梯度，两种记忆
figures.summary: 单坐标示例：前20步 g²=4，之后 g²=1；泄漏平均从 s₀=0 开始。 步间连线仅供阅读。
figures.code: function draw({board,width,height,progress,params}) { const P=VisualBook.palette, gamma=params.gamma, T=1+39*progress; const ema=[0], mean=[0]; let total=0; for(let t=1;t<=40;t++){const q=t<=20?4:1; total+=q; ema[t]=gamma*ema[t-1]+(1-gamma)*q; mean[t]=total/t;} const sample=a=>{const n=Math.floor(T),f=T-n;return a[n]+f*((a[n+1]??a[n])-a[n]);}; const prefix=a=>{const pts=[];for(let t=1;t<=Math.floor(T);t++)pts.push([t,a[t]]);pts.push([T,sample(a)]);return pts;}; const mobile=width<500; const f=board.axes('response-axes',{xDomain:[0,40],yDomain:[0,4.5],xLabel:'迭代步 t',yLabel:'平方梯度尺度',box:[48,78,width-22,height-115],grid:true}); board.line('legend-ema',48,45,67,45,P.blue,3);board.text('legend-ema-text','泄漏平均',74,50,{size:13,color:P.blue});board.line('legend-mean',mobile?180:220,45,mobile?199:239,45,P.ink,2);board.text('legend-mean-text','全历史均值',mobile?206:246,50,{size:13,color:P.ink}); board.curve('input',f,[[1,4],[20,4],[20,1],[40,1]],{color:P.orange,width:1.5,opacity:0.6});board.text('input-key','橙线：输入 g²',width-22,18,{anchor:'end',size:12,color:P.orange}); board.curve('ema-future',f,ema.slice(1).map((v,i)=>[i+1,v]),{color:P.blue,width:2,opacity:0.17});board.curve('mean-future',f,mean.slice(1).map((v,i)=>[i+1,v]),{color:P.ink,width:2,opacity:0.13});board.curve('ema-past',f,prefix(ema),{color:P.blue,width:3});board.curve('mean-past',f,prefix(mean),{color:P.ink,width:2});board.line('cursor',f.x(T),f.top,f.x(T),f.bottom,P.muted,1,0.35);board.circle('ema-dot',f.x(T),f.y(sample(ema)),4.5,P.blue);board.circle('mean-dot',f.x(T),f.y(sample(mean)),3.5,P.ink);board.text('time', 't = '+T.toFixed(1),48,height-42,{size:13,color:P.muted});board.text('ema-value','泄漏 '+sample(ema).toFixed(3),mobile?155:width*0.38,height-42,{size:14,color:P.blue});board.text('mean-value','均值 '+sample(mean).toFixed(3),mobile?48:width*0.7,mobile?height-16:height-42,{size:14,color:P.ink});return {gamma,time:T,ema:sample(ema),historicalMean:sample(mean),inputBefore:4,inputAfter:1,changeAfterStep:20,emaAt40:ema[40],meanAt40:mean[40],interpolation:'adjacent discrete states'}; }

figures.title: “十步记忆”没有硬边界
figures.summary: 以下按递推式计算无限历史权重，半衰期满足 γᵏ=1/2。
figures.code: function draw({board,width,height,progress,params}) {const P=VisualBook.palette,g=params.gamma,k=40*progress,relative=Math.pow(g,k),near=1-relative,half=Math.log(0.5)/Math.log(g); const f=board.axes('memory-axes',{xDomain:[0,40],yDomain:[0,1.08],xLabel:'距今 / 步',yLabel:'相对新观测的权重',box:[48,55,width-22,height-147],grid:true});const pts=Array.from({length:161},(_,i)=>[i/4,Math.pow(g,i/4)]);board.curve('weights',f,pts,{color:P.blue,width:2.5});board.line('half-horizontal',f.x(0),f.y(0.5),f.x(half),f.y(0.5),P.muted,1,0.6);board.line('half-vertical',f.x(half),f.y(0.5),f.x(half),f.bottom,P.muted,1,0.6);board.circle('half-dot',f.x(half),f.y(0.5),3,P.muted);board.text('half-label','减半 '+half.toFixed(2)+' 步',width-22,25,{anchor:'end',size:13,color:P.ink});board.line('age-cursor',f.x(k),f.top,f.x(k),f.bottom,P.orange,1.3,0.65);board.circle('age-dot',f.x(k),f.y(relative),5,P.orange);const left=48,right=width-22,bw=right-left,y=height-76;board.rect('mass-background',left,y,bw,10,P.faint);board.rect('mass-near',left,y,bw*near,10,P.blue);board.rect('mass-tail',left+bw*near,y,bw*relative,10,P.orange,{opacity:0.65});board.text('near-label','近 '+k.toFixed(1)+' 步 '+(near*100).toFixed(1)+'%',left,height-51,{size:13,color:P.blue});board.text('tail-label','更早 '+(relative*100).toFixed(1)+'%',right,height-51,{anchor:'end',size:13,color:P.orange});board.text('current-weight','该观测权重 '+((1-g)*relative).toFixed(4),left,height-29,{size:12,color:P.muted});board.text('half-formula','半衰期 = ln(1/2) / ln γ',left,height-7,{size:12,color:P.muted});return {gamma:g,age:k,relativeWeight:relative,observationWeight:(1-g)*relative,halfLife:half,recentMass:near,earlierMass:relative,recent10Mass:1-Math.pow(g,10),infiniteWeightSum:1,zeroInitialized40WeightSum:1-Math.pow(g,40),meaning:'integer ages are discrete; fractional ages interpolate exponentially'};}
